title: Setup: Settings sidebar and hub disagree — "Email" vs "Mail Delivery", SMS and Data Lifecycle missing from the sidebar (#27521 row 3)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 3 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator in Setup. What happens: the sidebar says "Email" where the hub card says "Mail Delivery"; the hub lists SMS Delivery and Data Lifecycle, the sidebar has neither, so two of the settings pages cannot be reached from the sidebar and one page has two names. Reach: every administrator.

## Mechanism

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`, Configuration group: `nav_settings_mail` is labelled `'Email'` (line 140 on main), and no entry exists for SMS Delivery or Data Lifecycle.
- Against the manifests' `title` in `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/*` (the hub reads those).

Measured at `main` @ `561b7642`, re-driven (stock `examples/app-showcase --seed-admin`, admin, Chromium 1440×900).

## Wanted

One name per settings page, the same in the sidebar and the hub, and the same set of pages in both.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The sidebar label for the mail page equals the hub card's title (in en and the shipped packs).
- [ ] SMS Delivery and Data Lifecycle are reachable from the sidebar, or the hub and sidebar otherwise list the same set.
- [ ] A test pins sidebar entries against the settings manifests so the two cannot drift again.

Refs #27521
